### Jezebel’s Road
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-18-2023.html
Passage: Revelation 2:20, 24-26
Points:
- The church in Thyatira showed commendable faith and growth, yet tolerated a false teacher who excused idolatry and immorality.
- This corrupt teaching sought to sever faith from obedience, telling believers they could compromise with pagan culture without consequence.
- Jesus placed no extra burden on the faithful believers, commanding them simply to hold fast until He returns.
- Christians facing modern pressure to compromise their standards are assured they will reign with Christ if they overcome.
- The perseverance required to resist moral compromise is sustained by God's own keeping power.

### To The Church at Thyatira II
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/to-the-church-at-thyatira-ii
Passage: Revelation 2:24-29
Points:
- Believers in Thyatira were tempted to compromise their convictions for economic survival within pagan trade guilds.
- Jesus takes note of those who remain faithful to Him, even when standing firm brings social or financial loss.
- Overcomers are promised eternal vindication through sharing in Christ's rule and judgment over the nations.
- The highest reward promised to faithful believers is the morning star, which is Christ Himself.
- Even when our diligence goes unnoticed by others in the church, Jesus sees and remembers our faithful endurance.
